app.label: SAAF agent · Joiners, movers and leavers
app.title: Every access right, traced to its request.
app.lede: The agent reads HR, the directory, the ERP and Jira. It tests twelve joiner, mover and leaver controls and returns each exception with its source. Claude drafts the findings. You sign off.

s2.title: Twelve controls, tested on every record.
s2.lede: The tests are deterministic: no model is involved, and the same data always gives the same result.
s2.engine: Baseline checks reuse the Track 2 access review engine by Bart van den Broek.

s4.lede: Claude Code runs on this machine with every tool switched off. It receives the exceptions as pseudonymised records, such as USER-019, and nothing else. Every finding it returns is checked against the input.

report.title: Joiners, movers and leavers access review
report.draft: Draft. Not signed off by an auditor.
report.footer: Generated by the joiners-movers-leavers agent {version}. Tests are deterministic. Findings mode: {mode}.
summary.J1: {name} received {entitlements} in the period without an approved Jira ticket.
summary.J2: {name} received {entitlements}, which no approved ticket requested ({requested}).
summary.J3: {name} received {entitlements} {days} day(s) before {ticket} was approved on {approved}.
summary.J4: {ticket} for {name} was raised and approved by the same person ({approver}).
summary.J5: {tickets} for {name} was approved without naming the roles to grant; {entitlements} was provisioned on it.
summary.M1: {name} moved from {previous_role} to {new_role} on {transfer} and still holds {entitlements} from the previous role (SLA {sla} days).
summary.M3: After the transfer on {transfer}, the directory still shows {dir_department} / {dir_role} while HR shows {hr_department} / {hr_role}.
summary.L1: {name} left on {termination}, but the directory account is still enabled on {date}.
summary.L2: {name} left on {termination}; access was removed up to {days} days later ({items}). SLA is {sla} day(s).
summary.L3: {name} left on {termination}, but the directory account was used on {login} ({days} days later).
summary.B2: Account enabled for a person who left before the period: {name} ({username}).
test.J1: Access granted without an approved ticket
test.J5: Request does not specify the access
test.M1: Previous role access not removed after transfer
test.M3: Directory profile not updated after transfer
test.L1: Directory account still enabled after termination
test.L2: Access removed later than the SLA
test.L4: Application access still assigned after termination
test.B2: Account enabled for a person who left before the period
report.subtitle: Joiner, mover and leaver access, tested against HR events and Jira access requests, {start} to {end}.
report.running: SAAF · Joiners, movers and leavers access review
report.synthetic: Synthetic data. The organisation, people and tickets are fictional.
report.assess.intro: Each exception was assessed against its source records. "Needs follow-up" means the records allow a legitimate explanation that the auditor must verify with management.
report.exc.intro: All exceptions returned by the deterministic tests, grouped by lifecycle, with the source rows each one rests on.
report.ap.1: Twelve JML controls and five baseline account checks ran on every record in the period. No model is involved: the same data always gives the same result.
report.ap.2: Claude Code received the exceptions in pseudonymised form, with every tool switched off, and drafted the assessments and findings.
report.ap.3: Every finding was checked against the SAAF finding schema and the input. Findings that cite unknown records are rejected. An auditor signs off.
report.ap.limits: Limitations: the agent tests the exports it is given and does not verify their completeness against the source systems. Approver authority, application logins and removal tickets are not tested. Root causes are hypotheses until management confirms them.
